subject.title: Bug: preflight (budget-triggered) compaction hard-capped at ~60s, ignores compaction.timeoutSeconds

question: Should required budget/preflight compaction ignore the normal reply lifecycle TimeoutError while still honoring explicit stop/restart cancellation, and should the optional preflight config gate stay separate?
rationale: Current source proves the bug path, but the durable behavior is a cancellation-contract choice with session-state and availability impact, and existing PRs propose different shapes.

options.title: Land filtered cancellation fix
options.body: Accept the open candidate path where lifecycle TimeoutError is filtered for required preflight compaction while explicit and non-timeout aborts still cancel.

options.title: Require live slow-backend proof first
options.body: Keep the issue and candidate PR open until the reporter's slow-backend class is reproduced with redacted runtime evidence.

options.title: Prefer a config gate direction
options.body: Reject or defer the cancellation-contract fix and sponsor an explicit preflight.enabled-style operator escape hatch instead.

recommendation.title: Land filtered cancellation fix
recommendation.body: Accept the open candidate path where lifecycle TimeoutError is filtered for required preflight compaction while explicit and non-timeout aborts still cancel.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-source history points this area through Vincent Koc, and the decision spans current preflight runtime behavior rather than only one older feature commit.
